name: Frappe/ERPNext Federated Bridge
description: Permission-scoped Frappe/ERPNext tools with federated OAuth identity and an executable enterprise read model. Frappe remains the authorization authority. SQLite provides local/test persistence while the Postgres deployment contract preserves the same site, principal, permission-epoch, and revision boundaries. Customer deployments are data-only profiles; no customer-specific answers live in the pack code.
status: v0.6 beta: executable SQLite read-model storage, Postgres deployment contract, zero-app REST/OAuth polling, optional idempotent event ingestion, full metadata/customization indexing, revision-scoped caches, complete permission epochs, live-field hierarchy scope, signed one-use write approvals, and data-only customer profiles. Frappe remains the authorization authority; cached answers are keyed by site, principal, permission epoch, schema revision, and data revision.

notes: FRAPPE_APPROVAL_SIGNING_KEY and FRAPPE_READ_MODEL_PATH are required only when executing bound write approvals.
OAuth token providers can supply user access tokens to the zero-app poller without persisting tokens in the read model.
profiles/oxygenhr.sanitized.json is example deployment data, not customer-specific code.
